integrity: All stated finite-state computations are independently replayable from check_finite.py; infinite conclusions rest on the analytical proof. No external validation.
scientific_limitations: Fixed sleep probability; sink strength q_n sqrt(n) tends to a strictly positive finite constant. Weak convergence only, not moment convergence or a quantitative rate. Generic OU maximum laws are known; application to critical stationary activated-random-walk occupancy is the claimed contribution. Priority is provisional.
title: The Ornstein–Uhlenbeck supremum law at the critical sink scale of complete-graph activated random walk
